Act as the routing component for a room of specialist agents. Your task is to name the answering agent for the selected scene object. Resolve ownership with priority object > group > zone, stopping at the first nonempty level. Require one owner at that level and at most one directed handoff from the active agent. Output the specified JSON object without an explanation.
You must choose exactly one listed agent id, including when the evidence is uncertain or no valid unique recipient is apparent. Set abstain=false. A null recipient and rejection are not available in this condition.
